data_fields.name: scene_cap_ratio
data_fields.donor_constant: 5/4 of (30 x loaded chunks), integer floor

data_fields.name: respawn_s
data_fields.donor_constant: none (refill only when a chunk loads)

data_fields.name: despawn_grace_s
data_fields.donor_constant: none (entities destroyed on the frame their chunk frees)

best_idea: Keep a square window of zone chunks around the player, diff it into load and free lists, and cap the population as a function of how much of the world is loaded, filling only the missing share as each chunk enters.
decision_why: The window diff and the loaded-area cap fit zones as data, but the donor only acts on chunk load, has no respawn timer or despawn grace, and does not save kills, so respawn must move to a server timer in the ledger.
acceptance: A server test kills an enemy in zone A, walks out and back inside the respawn timer, and asserts the enemy is still dead; after the timer, and with the player in the zone, a fresh spawn appears and the live count for zone A never exceeds its cap.
